name: SearchField
summary: A search box: a search icon, a search input, a clear button while there is a query, an optional end slot and a loading state.
useWhen: Filtering a list, a table or a grid on the same page as the person types
A search box in a toolbar, a sidebar or a menu that runs a search on Enter
A query the person often clears and types again
avoidWhen: Picking one value from a list of known options while typing
A command palette that runs actions
A plain text value that is not a query

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density. The clear button is xs, and sm at lg.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style, a pill in Studio and Desk. pill is always fully round.

value.description: The query, controlled. Pair it with onValueChange.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new query on every edit, and with an empty string when the clear button or Escape clears it.

onSubmit.description: Called with the query on Enter. A form around the field still submits as usual.

onClear.description: Called after the clear button or Escape clears the query.

clearLabel.description: The accessible name of the clear button.

loading.description: Results are on their way: a spinner at the start of the end slot and a polite status. The end content stays, so a focused end button keeps focus.

loadingLabel.description: What the status says while loading.

end.description: Content after the clear button: a filter IconButton at size xs, or a keyboard hint (Kbd, once that component lands). The spinner shows before it while loading.

invalid.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input. Inside a Field it follows the Field. Hides the clear button.

readOnly.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field. Hides the clear button; Escape does not clear.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

a11y.role: searchbox, from the native input with type search. Wrap a site or app search in a form or an element with role search; a filter for one list needs no landmark.
a11y.focus: The input is a tab stop, then the clear button while it shows, then any end content. Clicking the box outside a button focuses the input. Clearing returns focus to the input.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, then to the clear button and the end content
keys.Escape: Clears the query, before a Dialog or Popover around it sees the key, so they stay open. On an empty box it does nothing here, so the layer around it closes
keys.Enter: Calls onSubmit with the query; a form around it submits. An Enter that ends an IME composition does nothing

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label or aria-label. While loading, a polite status says the loading label once. The clear button is named by clearLabel.
notes: The browser's own clear button is hidden, so only one clear button shows.
No native title attribute. A placeholder says what is searched, never instead of a name.
Results that update as the person types: announce the count in a polite status of the page, after typing pauses, not on every key.
The clear part is an IconButton until CloseButton (order 1.1.9) lands; the part name stays clear.
The control part is the nested Input root; the native input inside it is that Input's own control part.

en.label: Search plus what is searched: Search boards, Search members.
en.placeholder: The same words as the name, or what can be typed: Search by name or email.

ar.label: البحث في اللوحات، البحث في الأعضاء

react.behavior: hand built on Input with type search
react.note: The root is the bordered box; the nested Input is the control part and keeps the Field wiring and the ref. The focus glow fades in as on Input; the spinner stops under reduced motion.

styles.studio: The Input look: a bordered transparent pill, the soft glow and the 2px ring on focus, a muted search icon at the start.
styles.desk: The same pill and glow, in Instrument Sans.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: An Input with type search and a second clear button next to the browser's own
mistakes.right: SearchField, which hides the native one

mistakes.wrong: Escape that clears and closes the dialog around the field in one press
mistakes.right: The first Escape clears; only an Escape on the empty box reaches the dialog

mistakes.wrong: A placeholder as the only name
mistakes.right: aria-label in a toolbar, a Field label in a form

mistakes.wrong: Announcing the result count on every key
mistakes.right: One polite status after typing pauses
